question: In which of the following years was the Bandhan Financial Services Private Limited set up to alleviate poverty and women empowerment?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2001**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bandhan Financial Services Private Limited was established in **2001 **with the primary goal of alleviating poverty and empowering women in India.
 
• It began as a microfinance institution, focusing on providing small loans to low-income individuals and self-help groups, primarily women, who lack access to traditional banking services.
 
• By offering affordable credit, Bandhan aimed to enable these marginalized communities to start or expand small businesses, generate income, and improve their livelihoods.
 
• This approach not only empowers women economically but also contributes to overall economic growth and poverty reduction.
 
• Bandhan's focus on women empowerment is particularly noteworthy.
 
• By providing financial access to women, it recognizes their crucial role in household economies and empowers them to make independent decisions and contribute to their families' well-being.
 
• Furthermore, Bandhan's commitment to financial inclusion extends beyond just providing loans. It also offers a range of financial services, such as savings accounts, insurance, and pension plans, to cater to the diverse needs of its customers. This comprehensive approach helps individuals build financial stability and security.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Founded: **2001
 
• **Focus: **Microfinance, financial inclusion, women empowerment
 
• **Services:** Microloans, savings accounts, insurance, pension plans
 
• **Impact: **Reduced poverty, empowered women, contributed to economic growth
